events.title: THE DEMO IS LIVE
events.summary: After some time playtesting, refining and (hopefully) finding all the bugs; the demo for King's Haven is now live! The demo is a limited slice of what the full game will offer in terms of cards, characters, landmarks, bosses and events. If you haven't played yet, or are returning from the playtests, i hope you enjoy the demo! All feedback is encouraged as i continue to improve the game! Oh, and thanks for 1000 wishlists!
